result.title: Correctness Conditioning as Selection in Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Evaluation
result.summary: Restricting chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness evaluation to correctly answered instances changes the population being measured. We study this selection step in a seven-variable structural causal model and derive the exact observed gap $Δ= \operatorname{Cov}(A, C)/P(C=1)$. The model distinguishes difficulty confounding from shortcut-induced collider bias and states the conditional-independence assumption needed to express the gap through latent response propensities. A protocol review of 18 papers distinguishes answer-correctness restrictions from agreement-based selection, benchmark construction, and training-data filtering. We evaluate four sub-ceiling deployments on arithmetic tasks and observe positive selection gaps in all four. The primary GLM-5.3 run yields a +7.4 percentage-point gap ($n = 1000$, $p < 0.0001$), and pooled Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel analysis gives OR = 1.70 ($p < 10^{-6}$). An assumption-free covariance decomposition assigns 42.8% of the GLM-5.3 gap to between-stratum variation in interventionable-operation count, leaving the majority unattributed. When counterfactual compliance is observable for every instance, evaluating all traces directly estimates population faithfulness without correctness filtering.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把「只统计答对样本」的 CoT 忠实性评估视为一次样本选择操作，在七变量结构因果模型中推导观测差距 Δ=Cov(A,C)/P(C=1)，用于区分难度混杂与捷径引入的对撞偏倚，并复核 18 篇论文的评估协议、在四个模型上报告选择差距均为正。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以正确性为条件会引入 collider bias、需用协方差分解归因」的因果工具可供核查 LVR 忠实性评价：例如判断答案是否真的使用 latent 视觉内容时，按答对筛选或按一致性分组可能污染结论；论文为纯文本 CoT，迁移适用性仍需核查。
